patch.description: Qwen3-based code generation model for repository understanding and multi-turn tool interaction.
patch.notes: July 28, 2025 is the snapshot date; Alibaba lists the Global/International service release on July 29. Exact hosted-alias parameter counts, architecture and open-checkpoint equivalence are not established. Current official overview says thinking mode is supported, conflicting with catalog reasoning=false; detailed regional function-calling tables also differ.

summary: Correct release date from snapshot date to explicit July 29 service release and narrow the description. Confirm 1M context, text modalities and tool interaction. Keep parameter counts and architecture null; do not infer 30B/3B or MoE from a separate checkpoint. Open weights and thinking mode remain unresolved, with official capability inconsistencies recorded.
